metadata.description: Curated Claude plugins for Branch8. Only plugins with no Anthropic-listed equivalent live here - everything Anthropic already ships is enabled from the official marketplace instead. Third-party code is vendored under vendor/ at a pinned commit.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence: searchable local database of styles, palettes, font pairings, chart types and per-stack guidelines. Vendored from nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill - do not edit by hand, run scripts/vendor.py.

plugins.name: branch8-jira-check
plugins.description: Session-start Jira workflow: checks the Atlassian MCP connection and offers to connect, records each project's Jira board locally, and asks for (or creates) a Jira ticket for every new task. Adds /jira-check and /jira-board.

plugins.name: branch8-jira-mod
plugins.description: Optional extension to branch8-jira-check: shows the current Jira ticket above the prompt, /jira-todo lists your open tickets to pick from, reminds Claude at start / PR / merge points. Needs Claude Code v2.1.287+ (desktop v2.1.286+).

plugins.name: branch8-auth-check
plugins.description: One place for every sign-in: Jira, GitHub (gh), Devin DeepWiki, Gemini. Shows one status line on the first turn and, when a task needs a service that is not signed in, asks with a card and walks the user through sign-in or tells them who to ask for an account. Adds /auth-check.

plugins.name: branch8-deepwiki
plugins.description: DeepWiki as a knowledge source: Devin MCP (OAuth) for Branch8's own repos indexed in Devin, public DeepWiki MCP (no auth) for open-source repos, plus a skill telling Claude when and how to query them.

plugins.name: branch8-practices
plugins.description: Branch8's way of working with Claude. rd-before-coding: before coding a feature-sized ticket, Claude pairs with the RD to understand the requirement, review the PRD (questions back to the PM on Jira) and design the solution, leaving a record in the repo and a self-contained Jira summary.
